shared_elements: schematic body parts such as eyes/heads
outlined figures with internal incised/detail lines
justification: The strongest shared content is the use of schematic outlined profile creatures or creature-like figures combined with repeated short linear/hatching details. The biggest difference is that A is organized as stacked horizontal registers with multiple separate animals and patterned bands, while B is a circular composition dominated by a single central anthropomorphic/winged figure enclosed by curved bands.
